description: Mediation Boards Commission - Notice of Calling for Nominations to appoint persons to be Mediators
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the appointment of mediators to special mediation boards, which falls under judicial/law enforcement matters. It involves the selection and appointment process for individuals who will serve in a quasi-judicial capacity to settle financial disputes, operating under the authority of the Mediation Boards Commission established by law. The content focuses on the qualifications, nomination process, and appointment procedures for these dispute resolution roles, which is characteristic of Type 9 (Judicial/Law Enforcement) gazettes rather than government personnel changes or other specialized categories.
